                                                ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO


SECTION 1.      Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe RS-3 Residential Single-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on

Map No. 3-J in an area bound by:




A line 38.70 feet north of and parallel to West Hirsch Street; the alley next east of and parallel to North

Avers Avenue; West Hirsch Street; and North Avers Avenue,




To those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.



SECTION 2.      This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.
